name: Serial Cost Grade Traceability
query:
SELECT
    sn.name AS "Serial No:Link/Serial No:150",
    sn.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:150",

    CASE
        WHEN sn.item_code LIKE '%%-B-S' THEN 'B'
        WHEN sn.item_code LIKE '%%-S' THEN 'A'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS "Grade:Data:70",

    origin.incoming_rate AS "Actual Cost/Unit:Currency:120",
    origin.posting_datetime AS "Cost Date:Datetime:145",

    origin.voucher_no AS "Origin Voucher:Data:160",
    origin.warehouse AS "Origin Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",

    prev.previous_serials AS "Previous Serial (A):Data:180",
    prev.repack_docs AS "Repack Document:Data:160",

    nxt.next_serials AS "Next Serial (B):Data:180",

    sn.status AS "Current Status:Data:100",
    sn.warehouse AS "Current Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    sn.customer AS "Customer:Data:150"

FROM `tabSerial No` sn

/* ต้นทุนรับเข้าครั้งแรกของ Serial นี้ */
LEFT JOIN `tabSerial and Batch Entry` origin
    ON origin.name = (
        SELECT e.name
        FROM `tabSerial and Batch Entry` e
        WHERE e.serial_no = sn.name
          AND e.item_code = sn.item_code
          AND e.type_of_transaction = 'Inward'
          AND e.qty > 0
          AND e.is_cancelled = 0
          AND e.docstatus = 1
        ORDER BY e.posting_datetime ASC, e.creation ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )

/* Serial เดิมที่ถูกนำมา Repack เพื่อสร้าง Serial ปัจจุบัน */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        e.fg_serial_no,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT old_sn.serial_no
            ORDER BY old_sn.serial_no
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS previous_serials,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT e.voucher_no
            ORDER BY e.voucher_no
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS repack_docs

    FROM `tabSerial and Batch Entry` e

    INNER JOIN `tabSerial No` old_sn
        ON old_sn.name = e.serial_no

    WHERE e.fg_serial_no IS NOT NULL
      AND e.fg_serial_no != ''
      AND e.is_cancelled = 0
      AND e.docstatus = 1

    GROUP BY e.fg_serial_no
) prev
    ON prev.fg_serial_no = sn.name

/* Serial ปัจจุบันถูกนำไปสร้าง Serial ใหม่ตัวใด */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        e.serial_no,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT new_sn.serial_no
            ORDER BY new_sn.serial_no
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS next_serials

    FROM `tabSerial and Batch Entry` e

    INNER JOIN `tabSerial No` new_sn
        ON new_sn.name = e.fg_serial_no

    WHERE e.fg_serial_no IS NOT NULL
      AND e.fg_serial_no != ''
      AND e.is_cancelled = 0
      AND e.docstatus = 1

    GROUP BY e.serial_no
) nxt
    ON nxt.serial_no = sn.name

WHERE
    (
        IFNULL(%(from_date)s, '') = ''
        OR DATE(origin.posting_datetime) >= %(from_date)s
    )

    AND (
        IFNULL(%(to_date)s, '') = ''
        OR DATE(origin.posting_datetime) <= %(to_date)s
    )

    AND (
        IFNULL(%(item_code)s, '') = ''
        OR sn.item_code = %(item_code)s
    )

    AND (
        IFNULL(%(serial_no)s, '') = ''
        OR sn.serial_no LIKE CONCAT('%%', %(serial_no)s, '%%')
    )

    AND (
        IFNULL(%(grade)s, '') = ''
        OR CASE
            WHEN sn.item_code LIKE '%%-B-S' THEN 'B'
            WHEN sn.item_code LIKE '%%-S' THEN 'A'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END = %(grade)s
    )

ORDER BY
    origin.posting_datetime DESC,
    sn.serial_no ASC
